Multiple new Apple products are reportedly set to be announced on October 13, including the rumored "HomePad" device. However, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says one rumored product won't be unveiled next month: a new full-size HomePod with Siri AI.

Bloomberg: Larger HomePod Won't Get October Update, New Version 'Eventually' Still Coming

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports today that Apple plans to announce three brand new home products in the near future.

The upcoming new products include:

The expected announcement date for each of the above products is Tuesday, October 13.

However, one major home product won't be launching in October. Gurman writes:

This is his only mention of the larger HomePod product, which hasn't been updated since 2023.

Gurman previously reported that the new full-size HomePod is being developed alongside an updated HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K. When asked about the timing, he said: "It's only a matter of time. They want Apple Intelligence and the new Siri features to be running smoothly on these products first before launching a new version."

Even though Siri AI has officially launched and the HomePod mini is ready to support it, fans of the larger HomePod will apparently need to be patient for a while longer before seeing a hardware update compatible with Siri AI.

Hopefully the wait won't be too long, because in a few more weeks, the full-size HomePod will be the only home product still running the older version of Siri.

Which new Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Are you planning to buy the new HomePod? Let us know in the comments.
